correctness.rationale: Canonical binary gap decomposition w=b^x a b^{u1}...a b^{u_(A-1)}a b^z has total interior d=sum uj and ab count Σ j uj+A z. Scattered a b^t a occurs iff d>=t, so avoiding words have d<=t-1. Weighted gap compositions give q^d Gaussian [A+d-2 choose d]_q and z contributes Σ_(z=0)^(B-d) q^(Az). For C<A, z=0; since B>=C and A-1>=C, the partitions of C are unrestricted except for at most t-1 parts. The full denominator Gaussian coefficient stabilizes to p(C). For fixed r=t-1, p_<=r(C)~C^(r-1)/(r!(r-1)!) and Hardy–Ramanujan p(C)~exp(pi sqrt(2C/3))/(4sqrt(3)C), giving 4sqrt(3) C^r/(r!(r-1)!) exp(-pi sqrt(2C/3)). Independent literal subsequence enumeration matched the polynomial on 84 parameter triples A=2..5,B=0..6,t=3..5. These are bounded checks.
